page.overview:
Who is Autograph Kids?

The Autograph Kids are minor characters in A Bug's Life.

"The Circus Bugs are determined to leave—until two young ants come into Francis' hospital room to ask for autographs. While signing leaves, the flattered circus bugs decide to stay. They can't let their fans down, after all."

The Autograph Kids get the autographs of the circus bugs, believing them to be warriors.
